title: Mac Packwala and the Cures of the Stale Cache.
author: helloLeoDiCaprio
selftext:
For anyone that likes development and the old point-and-click games, this is just a stupid game that took around a day to do. It can be played or downloaded at [https://macpackwala.workflows-of-ai.com/](https://macpackwala.workflows-of-ai.com/)

It was put together to teach people how to use AI together with the framework Drupal, but the story is generic enough so anyone can play it. 

You don't get speech until you pick up the text-to-speech module.

It is completely open source and can be found here: [https://github.com/ivanboring/Mac-Packwala-and-the-curse-of-the-stale-cache](https://github.com/ivanboring/Mac-Packwala-and-the-curse-of-the-stale-cache)

For anyone wanting to cheat: [https://macpackwala.workflows-of-ai.com/walkthrough.txt](https://macpackwala.workflows-of-ai.com/walkthrough.txt)
